questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Australia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Australia article.

questions.proof: Its capital city is Canberra, and its largest city is Sydney.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Australia?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Culture” part of the Australia article.

questions.proof: English is the main spoken language.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Australia supported the United States in wars against dictatorships in Korea and _____ and later Iraq.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Korea”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “The Commonwealth of Australia” part of the Australia article.

questions.proof: Australia supported the United States in wars against dictatorships in Korea and Vietnam and later Iraq.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In 1855, limited self-government was given by _____ to New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and Tasmania.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “given”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Self government” part of the Australia article.

questions.proof: In 1855, limited self-government was given by London to New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and Tasmania.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Australia, New Zealand, New _____ and other islands on the Australian tectonic plate are together called Australasia, which is one of the world's great ecozones.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Zealand”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Australia article.

questions.proof: Australia, New Zealand, New Guinea and other islands on the Australian tectonic plate are together called Australasia, which is one of the world's great ecozones.
